verdict.rationale: CoreWeave is a cloud provider, so data region and residency selection is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence never documents choosing a region or residency for stored data, for example when creating AI Object Storage buckets. The only location-related item is Capacity Finder, which compares compute placement availability across Zones for Spot Node Pools. That is an adjacent compute-placement feature, not a control over where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
